## 任务详情
Rework the existing SolutionPackage lifecycle so authoritative Package Envelope/descriptor/provenance and applicable SDK records, exact typed external content, and a package-owned executable semantic corpus are bound into one immutable release and reused unchanged through publish, install, final verification, and atomic ComponentInstall activation.

## 非目标
- Do not change adjacent domain ownership, add a generic plugin system, or introduce a second package, approval, catalog, installation, or verification source of truth.
- Do not broaden implementation ownership beyond internal/solutions/packages/** or change the existing worker, reviewer, dependencies, acceptance responsibility, or PR base.
- Do not let synthetic RegisterComponent/default facts, caller-shaped package records, an unscoped resolver, identity-only lookup, a self-hashed descriptor, or mutable catalog reads satisfy governed publish/install authority.
- Do not classify every generic ContentPackage as a data contract; resolve the exact Package Envelope descriptor and apply only the context-specific package/content/interface checks owned by that immutable release.
- Do not select production fixture source through OAC_SEMANTIC_FIXTURE_CORPUS, module-global embedded fallback, reference-only metadata, a legacy error-only/recording verifier, or hard-coded assertion labels; the selected SolutionPackage must own the canonical executable corpus payload.
- Do not make published releases mutable, partially activate Required members, replace an active Workflow LockedComponentSet, or treat retry as permission to overwrite an immutable release.
- Do not bypass authorization, admission, CAS, idempotency, PlanningAuthority, ValidatedPlan, Package/interface checks, audit/provenance evidence, or the Package/Solution lifecycle through generic Artifact approval.
- Do not replace already accepted publish/install lifecycle regressions with package-authority, corpus-ownership, descriptor/provenance, or catalog-drift regressions; all groups are mandatory in the same exact gate.
